CREATE TABLE "public"."EscalationPolicy" (
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "serviceId" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EscalationStep" (
  "acknowledgmentRequired" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "delaySeconds" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notificationChannels" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "policyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "position" int4 NOT NULL,
  "targetId" text NOT NULL,
  "targetType" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "EscalationStep_targetType_check_17501856" CHECK ("targetType" IN ('user', 'team', 'webhook'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."IncidentEscalation" (
  "acknowledgedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currentStep" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "incidentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nextEscalationAt" timestamptz,
  "policyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "IncidentEscalation_status_check_734f4e01" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'acknowledged', 'exhausted', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MaintenanceWindow" (
  "bypassSeverity" text,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" int4,
  "enabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "endsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "serviceId" int4,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "MaintenanceWindow_bypassSeverity_check_e5dcd509" CHECK ("bypassSeverity" IN ('sev1', 'sev2', 'sev3', 'sev4'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."NotificationDelivery" (
  "acknowledgedAt" timestamptz,
  "channel" text NOT NULL,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deliveredAt" timestamptz,
  "error" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "incidentId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "queueJobId" int4,
  "recipient" text NOT NULL,
  "sentAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "NotificationDelivery_status_check_bb8816fa" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'sent', 'delivered', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."QueueJob" (
  "attempts" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "companyId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "incidentId" int4,
  "lastError" text,
  "lockedUntil" timestamptz,
  "payload" jsonb NOT NULL,
  "runAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "QueueJob_status_check_d8313f9b" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')),
  CONSTRAINT "QueueJob_type_check_9fc40b9f" CHECK ("type" IN ('escalate', 'notify'))
)
